hydrateordiedrate:config-thirst-text:
Hydrate Or Diedrate Configuration
Customize every aspect of your hydration survival experience!

Thirst Settings:
- MaxThirst: Sets the maximum thirst level a player can have. Default: 1500.
- ThirstDamage: Determines the amount of damage taken per tick due to thirst. Default: 1 damage per tick.
- ThirstDecayRate: Base hydration decay per tick. This value is multiplied by factors such as movement. Default: 10.
- HydrationLossDelayMultiplier: Hydration loss duration multiplier for drinks. Higher values increase the delay before hydration starts depleting after drinking. Default: 0.05.
- EnableThirstMechanics: Toggles the thirst mechanic on or off.
- WaterSatiety: Satiety loss (negative) or gain (positive) from regular water (inventory only, not source block). See block hydration config for source block settings.
- SaltWaterSatiety: Satiety loss (negative) or gain (positive) from salt water (inventory only, not source block). See block hydration config for source block settings.
- BoilingWaterSatiety: Satiety loss (negative) or gain (positive) from boiling water (inventory only, not source block). See block hydration config for source block settings.
- RainWaterSatiety: Satiety loss (negative) or gain (positive) from rain water (inventory only, not source block). See block hydration config for source block settings.
- DistilledWaterSatiety: Satiety loss (negative) or gain (positive) from distilled water (inventory only, not source block). See block hydration config for source block settings.
- SprintThirstMultiplier: Multiplier for thirst decay rate while sprinting. Default: 150% or 1.5.
- EnableBoilingWaterDamage: Toggles damage when attempting to drink boiling water.
- BoilingWaterDamage: Damage taken for drinking boiling water. Default: 5 damage.

Movement Speed Penalty Settings:
- MaxMovementSpeedPenalty: Movement speed reduction cap from being thirsty. Set to 1 to disable penalties.
- MovementSpeedPenaltyThreshold: Thirst level below which movement speed penalties begin to apply. Scaling starts from this point to zero based on the max movement speed penalty.

Liquid Encumbrance Settings:
- EnableLiquidEncumbrance: Toggles movement penalties from carrying liquids.
- EncumbranceLimit: How many liters a single inventory slot must exceed before liquid encumbrance is triggered.
- LiquidEncumbranceMovementSpeedDebuff: Movement speed reduction applied due to liquid encumbrance. Default: 40% or 0.4.

Temperature and Heat Settings:
- HarshHeat: Toggles whether high temperatures impact thirst.
- TemperatureThreshold: Temperature above which thirst increases faster.
- ThirstIncreasePerDegreeMultiplier: Governs how much thirst decay rate increases per degree above the temperature threshold.
- HarshHeatExponentialGainMultiplier: Overall thirst increase in extreme heat. This value is highly sensitive to change.
- ThirstDecayRateMax: Maximum thirst decay rate in hot environments. Default: 500% or 5.0.

Cooling Factors:
- UnequippedSlotCooling: Cooling from empty equipment slots. Each valid empty clothing slot provides cooling equivalent to the cooling stat on clothing.
- WetnessCoolingFactor: Cooling effect from being wet.
- ShelterCoolingFactor: Cooling effect from being under shelter. Shelters are base-game rooms.
- SunlightCoolingFactor: Governs how much cooling is impacted by sunlight exposure. Higher values make shade more effective.
- DiurnalVariationAmplitude: Time-of-day cooling effect.
- RefrigerationCooling: Cooling provided by refrigeration system from medieval expansion ice.

XSkills Settings:
- DromedaryMultiplierPerLevel: Thirst reduction per Dromedary level.
- EquatidianCoolingMultipliers: Cooling multipliers for equatorial regions.

Rain Gathering Settings:
- EnableRainGathering: Toggle rainwater collection.
- RainMultiplier: Adjust rainwater collection rate.
- EnableParticleTicking: Toggle rainwater particle effects.

Keg Settings:
- KegCapacityLitres: Max capacity of a keg.
- SpoilRateUntapped: Spoilage rate for untapped kegs.
- SpoilRateTapped: Spoilage rate for tapped kegs.
- KegIronHoopDropChance: Chance for ferro hoops to drop when recycling.
- KegTapDropChance: Chance for a keg tap to drop when recycling.

Tun Settings:
- TunCapacityLitres: Max capacity of a tun.
- TunSpoilRateMultiplier: Spoilage rate multiplier for a tun.

hydrateordiedrate:survivalinfo-thirst-te:
Sede
Sensação de boca seca?Sua sobrevivência agora depende de mais do que apenas comida!

O Mecânica de Sede adiciona um novo desafio de sobrevivência às suas aventuras. Mantenha-se hidratado ou enfrente as consequências!

Barra de sede: Fique de olho na sua barra de sede, que diminui gradualmente com o tempo. Climas quentes fazem a sede diminuir ainda mais rápido, então gerencie sua hidratação com cuidado ao viajar para o sul!

Influência do Clima:: Temperaturas altas aceleram a perda de sede. Use roupas refrescantes ou busque abrigo para reduzir o ritmo. Ficar molhado também ajuda a se refrescar, e às vezes usar menos roupa pode ser a melhor opção..

Morte: Falhar em se hidratar resultará em morte — e rapidamente! O dano por sede é aproximadamente o dobro do dano por fome.

Sobrecarga de Líquidos: Carregar mais de 4 litros (padrão) de líquido em um recipiente reduzirá sua velocidade de movimento. Planeje seu armazenamento com sabedoria..

Hidratação por Comida e Bebidas: todos os itens de comida e bebida agora possuem um status de hidratação. Itens especiais, como sopas e sucos, pausam temporariamente a sede, enquanto o álcool proporciona um alívio ainda maior, graças à forma única como os Seraphs o processam.

Fontes de Água::Beba diretamente de fontes de água segurando shift + rightmouseem um bloco de líquido. No entanto, beber assim aumenta a fome, então processar bebidas ou fazer sopas é um método mais eficiente de hidratação. Água salgada é extremamente perigosa para beber — tome cuidado ao beber de fontes naturais..

Coleta de Água da Chuva: Todos os recipientes de líquido agora podem coletar água da chuva quando colocados do lado de fora durante uma tempestade. A água da chuva é um ótimo recurso no início e meio do jogo, pois repõe mais sede e reduz a fome pela metade em comparação com a água comum..

Barrís Você pode criar Barrís Barrísusando madeira, gravetos e aros de ferro. Inicialmente sem torneira, eles são usados para armazenamento de líquidos a longo prazo. Para instalar uma torneira, forje um Torneira de Barril comLatãomartele-a no lugar com a torneira na mão e um martelo na mão secundária (segure Botão Direito). Isso permite adicionar e remover líquidos do barril. Lembre-se: barris podem ser reciclados com um machado (segure rightmouse), mas há uma chance de perder parte do metal no processo..

Déficit Nutricional: Tome cuidado com líquidos que possuem valores negativos de saciedade, pois eles podem causar um Déficit Nutricional, indicado por um marcador laranja na barra de saciedade. Enquanto houver qualquer déficit nutricional, a comida não fornecerá nutrição. Cada ponto de saciedade consumido reduzirá gradualmente o déficit até zerar.
hydrateordiedrate:wellinfo-text:
Shallow Well
Shallow wells are accesible as soon as you make your first shovel, which makes it the earliest well you can make. Simply use toolmodeselect to switch to the 'Dig Well Spring ' mode and dig into a soil/gravel/sand block near water (up to 3 blocks away from the water) and it will slowly generate a layer of Muddy Well Água.

Note: unlike deep wells, shallow wells do not require a shaft with walls surounding it to fill up.

Deep Well
To create a deep well you will first need a pickaxe, simply dig straight down and when you think the well is deep enough use toolmodeselect to switch to the 'Dig Well Spring ' mode and dig into a rock. It is recommended to build a Well Winch at the top so you can lower and raise a bucket to get the Well Água out more easily.

Deep wells generate a variable amount of Well Água every so often dependant on the aquifer rating (which is just a value associated with the chunk, not an actual block) The rating depends on a few factors:

- Existing water in the chunk column (more being better)
- A random chance for a random increases in rating (deeper being better)
- Neighboring aquifer rating (smoothing)

You can prospect to get a rough idea of how good the aquifer rating is and in which direction it gets stronger.

The amount of Well Água a deep well can retain can be upgraded by replacing the walls with better materials. Retention depth in blocks:

- default: 5
- bricks: 7
- ashlar: 10

Note: a full block is 70 liters.

Contamination
Wells can become contaminated and the only way to solve this is by emptying them of the polluted water, there are a few things you need to be carefull about:

- Although technically not considered pollution, building a well near salt water can cause it to generate Salty Well Água instead.
- The poison of Death Caps dissolves particularly well in water causing it to become Poisoned Well Água.
- Corpses in your well will turn the water into Tainted Well Água.
